title: From Single Spins to Ensembles: A Calibrated Symbolic Regression Pipeline for NV Spectroscopy
abstract: arXiv:2610.35016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Characterizing nitrogen-vacancy (NV) ensembles requires connecting their collective spectra to individual centers that experience different local environments. We develop a symbolic-regression pipeline that carries single-center spin structure into a calibrated ensemble model by generating individual spectral responses and combining them with explicit weights. A constrained search selects Hermitian operator terms from single-center optically detected magnetic resonance spectra, fits their coefficients, and retains the selected expressions as source models for the ensemble. Ensemble calibration then accounts for resonance shifts, local disorder, orientation, and optical response while keeping the individual spectral contributions accessible. On public single-center and ensemble data, the zero-field ensemble held-frequency root-mean-square error decreases from 0.008835 to 0.003872 in normalized photoluminescence, a 56.2% improvement over

translated_title: 从单个自旋到集合：面向NV光谱学的校准符号回归流水线
translated_abstract: 表征氮空位（NV）集合需要将其集体光谱与处于不同局部环境中的单个发光中心联系起来。我们开发了一个符号回归流水线，通过生成单个光谱响应并以显式权重将其组合，把单中心自旋结构带入到经过校准的集合模型中。一个约束搜索从单中心光探测磁共振光谱中选出厄米算符项，拟合其系数，并将选出的表达式保留作为集合的源模型。随后的集合校准则考虑了共振位移、局部无序、取向和光学响应，同时保持单个光谱贡献的可访问性。在公开的单中心和集合数据上，零场集合固定频率的归一化光致发光均方根误差从0.008835降至0.003872，相比原有方法实现了56.2%的提升。
tldr: 该论文开发了一个校准的符号回归流水线，将单中心NV自旋结构通过显式加权组合成集合光谱模型，并校准共振位移、局部无序、取向和光学响应等因素，使零场集合固定频率均方根误差降低56.2%。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a calibrated symbolic regression pipeline that carries single-center NV spin structure into an ensemble spectral model via explicit weighted combinations, accounting for resonance shifts, local disorder, orientation, and optical response, reducing zero-field ensemble held-frequency RMSE by 56.2%.
